artworks.title: Auteurs dramatiques
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted from the waist up at a table. The person on the left is leaning forward, with their face on their right hand, wearing a light-colored patterned jacket. The person on the right is seated with their elbows on the table, leaning towards the left individual, with a surprised or intrigued expression. They have round spectacles and a short hairstyle, wearing a dark jacket over a light shirt. Several open books or notebooks are on the table in front of them, suggesting a scholarly setting. The background is simple, with a few lines hinting at a wall or texture.

artworks.title: Eh bien! Vous voila capitaine de la garde nationale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays two men from the waist up. The man on the left has crossed arms, a prominent nose, receding hairline, and short, wavy hair. He wears a dark coat over a light shirt and appears amused. The man on the right faces forward but looks slightly left. He has a round face, prominent nose, and small round glasses. His disheveled hair sticks out from under an elaborate hat with a large pom-pom. He wears a patterned jacket over a white shirt with a scarf or cravat at the neck, holding a small round mirror in his right hand. The background is a simple white space with faint text pattern.

artworks.title: Le Md de Chaines de suretés
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts four men engaged in a conversation on a cobblestone street. The central figure is standing slightly to the left and leans forward, appearing to talk to the man to his right. He has a tall hat and holds a cane in one hand. To his right, another man leans forward with a hat. To the left, a man with bushy hair and a different style of hat holds a stack of papers or money. The fourth man, on the far right, bends slightly forward, also wearing a hat and holding a bag. The background features more men in hats in a shadowy street setting, creating a bustling street scene.

artworks.title: La Glaneuse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman walking. She is hunched slightly forward, holding a cloth sack close to her chest. She has exaggerated facial features with a prominent nose and cheekbones, and is wearing a bonnet. She is dressed in a long dress with a shawl. The background includes a tree on the left, a fence line, and a statue on a platform. The title caption reads "BOHÉMIENS DE PARIS."

artworks.title: Le Protecteur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a standing position, viewed from head to toe. The person on the left is standing upright with their hands tucked into their coat pockets. This person has a thin, elongated face with prominent facial features and is wearing a tall, black top hat. Their attire consists of a long, buttoned coat and dark trousers, with black shoes. The person on the right is leaning slightly forward, extending both arms towards the other person. This individual has a scruffy appearance with long hair and a beard. They are wearing a light-colored hat, a long coat identical to the first person, but the texture and fit appear more worn. The background is a simple, shaded wall.

artworks.title: L'ancien négociant
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing. The person on the left is hunched forward, holding a piece of paper with both hands. This individual has a receding hairline, tied back hair, and wears glasses, a long dark coat with patterned details, and dark pants. The person on the right stands upright with hands in pockets and looks towards the other individual. They have short, wavy hair and prominent facial features, wearing a white shirt, dark formal wear, and an open long coat. The background is a simple interior with a wall displaying the word "CAISSE" and a marked doorframe.

artworks.title: Le membre de toutes les académies
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a side profile position. He is leaning back with one hand tucked behind his back and the other holding a cane. The man has long hair extending below his hat, a top hat, overcoat, pants, and pointed shoes. He is wearing a white shirt and a dark cravat. The background shows an urban setting with buildings and a large, dome-like structure in the distance, suggesting a cityscape. The setting is drawn with a technique that emphasizes line shading. A caption appears at both the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Les comédiens de province
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals in conversation. The scene shows two figures standing and facing each other engaged in dialogue, with expressive body language highlighted by their postures. One figure is leaning slightly forward with arms crossed, while the other is leaning slightly backward. The characters are dressed in 19th-century attire, one wearing a top hat and the other a broad-brimmed hat. In the background, a wall features partial text. The drawing emphasizes the vivid expressions and interaction between the figures with strong linear details reminiscent of caricature.

artworks.title: L'amateur de café
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man depicted from the waist up, sitting in a sideways position. He is leaning forward with his head turned slightly to the side, gazing at a small cup he is holding in both hands. His facial features are expressive, with a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes. He appears to be middle-aged, with short, slightly disheveled hair under a tall top hat. The man is wearing a dark, oversized jacket with a high collar and a dark neck scarf. In front of him on the table is a set with a wine glass and a plate of biscuits or cakes. The background consists of text, including the title "MONOMANES" at the top and "L’AMATEUR DE CAFÉ" at the bottom, parts of a larger publication. The illustration has a sketch-like quality with shading and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Oui, monsieur, vous voyez en moi une victime
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration shows two full-body figures in a landscape setting. The person on the left is standing with a slightly hunched posture, facing the person on the right, holding a bundle on a stick over their shoulder. This person has curly hair and exaggerated facial features. They wear tattered clothing. The person on the right stands upright, one hand in their pocket and the other holding a piece of cloth. They wear a hat, spectacles, a jacket, and a shirt. Both figures are in a rural landscape with sparse trees, a distant building, and rocky ground.

artworks.title: Robert Macaire professeur de français
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classroom with a teacher and two students. The teacher is at the front of the room gesturing with one hand raised. There are two students, one leaning on the table and the other holding a piece of paper. The table has books, papers, and a hat on it. The style resembles that of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Mossieu le concierge
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. The first person, a man, is seated in a chair holding a newspaper. The second person, a woman, is seated at a desk. Nearby is a mantle with a decorative sculpture. In the background, the word "CONCIERGE" is visible on a window or sign.

artworks.title: Nous ne partirons donc pas!  -Hortense, je crois que ça va mordre . . . Rien plus qu'une petite demi-heure!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing side by side. The man on the right is holding a large umbrella over both individuals and a fishing rod in his other hand. He is wearing a tall top hat, a long coat, and long pants. The woman beside him is wearing a lengthy dress with many layers and a shawl on her head. They are standing on a shoreline with waves and wet sand. In the background, there is a seascape with distant clouds and rain.

artworks.title: Ne laissez donc pas votre ami dans cet état la!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In this image, three individuals are depicted. The first person, an elderly man, is shown standing on the left, with wrinkles, a prominent nose, a bald head, and wearing a tunic. He is gesturing with one hand and holding a walking stick. Next to him stands a younger man in a black suit with a waistcoat and a top hat. The third figure is seated or reclining on the ground, with disheveled hair, an open shirt, and a hat nearby. The background features sketched urban elements, suggesting a street scene, with lightly drawn building outlines.

artworks.title: Adieu! ... A la grâce de dieu ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three people. In the center, a man is seated behind a rectangular surface, with a surprised or singing expression. He wears a tall hat and a layered outfit. To his left is a young girl with an open mouth and wide eyes, wearing a bonnet and a dark dress. To his right, an elderly woman holds a sheet of paper. Behind them, a man is visible through a window with opened shutters, looking angry. The background is a simple wall with the window. The image has a sketched, monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Paganini moderne ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man playing a violin in profile, facing a music stand. He is wearing a long coat with patterns, dark trousers, and heeled shoes. The man's hair is light-colored, with smoke rising from it. He holds the violin under his chin and rests his right hand with the bow against his shoulder. Sheet music on the stand is illuminated by a nearby candle. In the background, there is a window, shelves, a bust, and some objects in an artistic sketch style.

artworks.title: Ou peut on être mieux ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in an illustrative style. In the foreground on the left, a young boy is depicted wearing a jacket, trousers, and a cap, and looking towards the musicians. Standing next to him is a man wearing a top hat, holding a spoon in his right hand. This man is behind a large drum, which he appears to be playing. Next to the drummer, another man is shown in profile, wearing a flat cap and a jacket, with his arms wrapped around the drum. On the right, a third man is shown playing a wind instrument, wearing a cap, a jacket, and trousers. His facial features include a prominent nose and a focused expression. The background illustrates a street setting, with cobblestone paving and the faint outline of a building. A caption at the bottom of the image reads "Les Musiciens de Paris" at the top.

artworks.title: La colére d'Agamemnon
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient history scene. The drawing depicts a muscular, armored figure in a commanding stance, gesturing towards another seated person. In the foreground, there are indications of a shield and military equipment. The figure wears a helmet with a plume and a skirt-like garment. The background includes outlines of tents or structures. The figures and elements have shading and strong lines.

artworks.title: Socrate chez aspasie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image portrays two figures in an indoor setting. One figure is an older man, standing on one foot with his chest exposed. He has a large beard and a bald head. The second figure is a woman standing facing the man. She is wearing a long robe with her hair tied back. The background features simple architectural elements like plain walls and a column. There is a chair draped with fabric near the man.

artworks.title: Ayant eu la facheuse idée d'aller ... au bord de l'eau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring a couple relaxing under trees. The scene is set in a wooded area with a dense canopy of foliage overhead, suggesting a private and shaded spot by the water's edge. One figure is lounging on the ground, and another appears seated with an outstretched arm. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketchy, and expressive style, capturing the tranquil yet casual moment filled with soft shadows and gentle movement from the surrounding environment. The trees are depicted with fluid lines that create a sense of depth and natural texture.

artworks.title: Marius a minturnes
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person emerging from a body of water surrounded by reeds. The drawing is divided into two distinct scenes: the upper part depicts figures in ancient Roman attire moving across a hillside, while the lower section shows a person partially submerged in water amidst tall reeds. There is a frog leaping through the reeds. The drawing is rendered in monochrome, using fine lines and shading to create texture and detail.

artworks.title: Télémaque et Mentor
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly bearded figure overseeing the fall of another figure. The elderly figure is standing atop a rocky surface, depicted with exaggerated features and a hunched posture, wearing a simple cloth garment and a headband. Beneath him, a second figure appears to be tumbling downward, with legs flailing in the air and what looks like a butterfly fluttering nearby. The composition conveys a sense of action. The drawing uses bold lines and shading to create depth and character expression, illustrating a narrative scene in a stark black-and-white manner. The drawing is characterized by exaggerated human forms typical of caricature art.

artworks.title: Télémaque rendu a la vertu
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures standing and facing each other. The person on the left is an elderly man with long white hair, a white beard, and a draped robe. The figure on the right is a younger individual dressed as a warrior, with a helmet, breastplate, skirt-like garment, and shield on their back. They are both in an outdoor setting with columns in the background.

artworks.title: Hippolyte lardé par Cupidon
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person reacting to a cherub with wings. The scene shows a cherubic figure in close proximity to an adult figure who appears surprised or concerned. The adult figure is seated with an exaggerated expression, wearing a tunic-style garment with bare feet. The background includes lightly sketched details of a rocky terrain or natural landscape. The cherubic figure, small with wings, looks towards the adult figure. The style is illustrative with a possible humorous or satirical tone. Text in French underneath may offer additional context or comedic caption.
